english:
Consumes 1 Ammo to fire a burst of 5 projectiles. Each projectile creates a lingering damage field 0.5 seconds after impact.

Fields last 5.65 seconds and deal <pve 52.5 /> <pvp [?] /> damage every 0.25 seconds, resulting in 22 damage ticks in total per field. Enemies can only take damage from a single field at a time.

source.text:
Shoots a burst of 5 projectiles at the cost of 1 Ammo.

Projectiles create a lingering damage field after 0.5 seconds of impacting.

Damaging Field deals damage every 0.25 seconds for 5.65 seconds, dealing 52.5 [?] damage up to 22 times per field.
Enemies can only receive damage from a single field at a time.
